layout.removedBody: You no longer have access to this workspace. Contact the owner if you think this is a mistake.
layout.errorBody: Something went wrong while checking your access to this workspace. This is usually temporary. Please try again.

invite.label: Team invite
invite.when: you invite someone to the workspace

billing.label: Billing and payment
billing.when: a payment fails (retry and cancellation notices)

instagram.label: Instagram connected
instagram.when: the client finishes connecting through the link you sent

notifications.noEmailType: This type isn't sent by email
notifications.noEmailTypeAria: {{label}}: this type isn't sent by email

emails.title: Automatic emails
emails.description: Emails your account sends on its own, listed for transparency. The first 3 are always sent; only the last one is up to you.
emails.sameControl: Same setting as in your Profile.

suas.title: Your notifications
suas.description: What shows up in the bell and what reaches your email. Personal preference: it only applies to you.

clientes.title: Your clients
clientes.description: Each client's monthly report and Hub reminders, one by one. The master switches turn everyone on or off at once.
clientes.monthlyReportHint: on the 1st of every month, with a PDF and a monthly summary
clientes.hubPendingHint: posts awaiting approval and unread messages · max. 1 email every 4h
clientes.footer: Clients with no email on file receive nothing. Add the email on the client's profile.
clientes.reactivateTitleFor: Turn Hub reminders back on for {{name}}?
clientes.reactivateBody: The client asked not to receive these emails. Turn them back on anyway?
clientes.clientSwitchAria: Email controlled by the client switches

phone.subtitle: What shows up in the bell and what reaches your email. Only applies to you.
phone.channelNote: The switches below turn the {{channel}} channel on and off.
phone.pausedFooter: {{channel}} channel paused: the types below stay locked until you unpause.

perfil.photoDescription: Visible to your team across the CRM: Deliveries, Tasks, Events and Messages. Clients don't see it.
perfil.marketingOn: You'll receive news and marketing communications by SMS and WhatsApp.
perfil.marketingOff: You won't receive marketing communications. Messages about your account are still sent.
perfil.restrictionBody: Workspace settings, Instagram sync and team member management are only available to owners and admins.
perfil.privacyBody: Choose which optional tools (usage analytics and support chat) may use your browser's storage.

workspace.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP. Max 2MB. Resized to 512px.
workspace.autoSyncHint: When on, Instagram data syncs automatically once a day.
workspace.importBody: Bring in clients, posts, deliveries and ideas from Notion, Trello, ClickUp or spreadsheets.

membros.title: Workspace team members
membros.onlyOwnersAdmins: Only owners and admins can invite with an elevated or custom role.

phone.footerManage: Tap a team member to change their role, turn on finance access or remove them.
phone.footerEmail: Tap a team member to see their email.
phone.invitesFooter: Swipe an invite to resend or cancel it.
phone.moreInviteActions: More actions for the invite to {{email}}

errors.notOwner: You don't have permission to manage roles.
errors.invalidName: Enter a name for the role.
errors.duplicateName: A role with this name already exists.
errors.roleInUse: Reassign the team members before deleting this role.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

papeis.changesApply_one: Changes apply right away to the 1 team member with this role.
papeis.changesApply_other: Changes apply right away to the {{count}} team members with this role.
papeis.serverNote: Modules tagged "server" are enforced in the database. The rest are enforced in the CRM interface.
papeis.emptyFooter: Tap + to create a custom role.
papeis.adminSummary: Edits everything · Finances per each admin's access

post_approved.label: Post approved by the client
post_approved.when: the client approves a post in the Hub

post_correction.label: Changes requested
post_correction.when: the client requests changes to a post

post_message.label: Message on a post
post_message.when: the client comments on a specific post

post_edit_suggestion.label: Edit suggestion
post_edit_suggestion.when: the client suggests or updates a text or caption change in the Hub

post_client_reference.label: Client references
post_client_reference.when: the client attaches photos, videos, PDFs or links to a post in the Hub

idea_submitted.label: Idea submitted
idea_submitted.when: the client submits an idea or request

briefing_answered.label: Briefing answered
briefing_answered.when: the client answers a briefing question

client_message.label: Client message
client_message.when: the client writes in the message feed

linha_editorial_aprovada.label: Editorial plan approved
linha_editorial_aprovada.when: the client approves the month's editorial plan in the Hub

linha_editorial_ajustes.label: Editorial plan changes
linha_editorial_ajustes.when: the client requests changes to the month's editorial plan in the Hub

post_assigned.label: Post assigned to you
post_assigned.when: a post is assigned to you

task_assigned.label: Task assigned to you
task_assigned.when: a task is created for you or reassigned to you

task_comment.label: Comment on a task
task_comment.when: someone comments on a task you take part in
task_comment.recipients: assignee, creator and earlier commenters, except the author and anyone mentioned

deadline_approaching.label: Deadline approaching
deadline_approaching.when: an active stage is due tomorrow

post_status_automation.label: Status automation
post_status_automation.when: one of your status rules triggers a notification

member_removed.label: Member removed
member_removed.when: a member is removed from the workspace

event_invited.label: Event invitations
event_invited.when: someone adds you to an event

event_updated.label: Event changes
event_updated.when: the time, location or recurrence of one of your events changes

event_cancelled.label: Cancelled events
event_cancelled.when: one of your events is cancelled or you are removed from it

event_rsvp.label: Replies to your invitations
event_rsvp.when: a participant replies to an event you organized

event_client_rsvp.label: Client replied to an event
event_client_rsvp.when: the client accepts or declines an event shared with them

event_guest_rsvp.label: External guest replied to an event
event_guest_rsvp.when: an external guest accepts or declines one of your events

event_reschedule_requested.label: Client asked to reschedule
event_reschedule_requested.when: the client asks to reschedule an event shared with them

event_reminder.label: Event reminders
event_reminder.when: at the reminder times you set

team_message.label: Team chat message
team_message.when: someone sends a message in a team chat conversation you are part of

post_discussion.label: Message in a post discussion
post_discussion.when: someone writes in the discussion of a post you follow
post_discussion.recipients: anyone who wrote in, was mentioned in or is responsible for the post and follows the discussion

instagram_connected_by_client.label: Instagram connected
instagram_connected_by_client.when: the client finishes connecting through the link you sent

post_publish_failed.label: Publishing failed
post_publish_failed.when: a scheduled post fails to publish

storage_autoclean_report.label: Storage cleanup
storage_autoclean_report.when: the nightly cleanup removes old files
